## Figma Design (Dark Mode): Ecosystem Compatibility

**Figma frame:** _Ecosystem Compatibility_
**Figma file:** https://www.figma.com/design/BSr242a615D8Lbg6WjT7l1/Use-stellar-design

> **Design-only issue** — work in Figma, not in code.
> **Depends on:** UI-17 (tokens and theme), UI-19 (cards, badges, and tags), UI-20 (responsive layout grid).

### Context

Section highlighting integration across Stellar tooling (wallets, Horizon, Soroban) with a supporting image.

### What to design (in Figma)

- Section heading, compatibility narrative, and supporting image.
- Clear visual treatment for wallets, Horizon, and Soroban integration.
- Responsive stacking and image treatment for smaller viewports.

### Deliverables

- Desktop and mobile ecosystem compatibility frames.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Wallet, Horizon, and Soroban compatibility are clearly represented
- [ ] Supporting image and copy have a balanced visual hierarchy
- [ ] Uses UI-17 tokens, UI-19 components where applicable, and UI-20 grid rules
- [ ] Dark-mode contrast is sufficient for copy, icons, and imagery
- [ ] Figma frame link is shared for review

### Important rules

- Get assigned before beginning work.
- Work only in the assigned Figma frame.
- Use the shared design system and reusable components; do not use loose styles.
- Dark mode only.
